Compare those winners in pairs, then compare the final two to find the minimum in seven comparisons total.

branches.title: How many comparisons does that take?
branches.source: Each match keeps only the smaller value because the larger one cannot be the overall minimum—we already know a smaller number exists. Advancing the smaller value ensures that an overall minimum reaches the final match.
